title: Towel Stand With 4 Pivoting Swing Arms 49-Inch Solid Brass Freestanding | Fire Engine Red | Assorted Free Standing Accessories | Allied Brass
short_title: Freestanding 4 Pivoting Swing Arm Towel Stand 49-Inch
description:
Keep towels organized and within reach without drilling into your walls in Fire Engine Red, which makes a fearless design statement, transforming functional bathroom hardware into a vibrant focal point. A bold choice for those who embrace color and personality in their space. This freestanding 4 pivoting swing arm towel stand creates flexible hanging space for bath towels and hand towels, with arms that swing for easy access and spacing.

Highlights:
- Fire Engine Red transforms this essential into a conversation piece
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Stay stable on the floor: large, weighted base is designed to help prevent tipping
- Built for enduring daily use: crafted from solid brass materials to resist rust and corrosion
- Coordinate your look: part of the Assorted Free Standing Accessories collection with multiple designer finish options

Specs & Installation:
- Product type: Freestanding towel stand (swing arm style)
- Arms: 4 pivoting swing arms
- Material: Solid brass
- Dimensions (L x H x W): 12 in. x 49 in. x 9.25 in.
- Assembly: Some assembly required
- Warranty: Limited lifetime warranty
- Assembled in the USA
